topic: Factors Affecting Rates of Chemical Reactions
key_concepts: Reaction rate can be observed through speed of bubbling or time for a reactant to dissolve
Increasing temperature generally increases reaction rate.
Increasing reactant concentration generally increases reaction rate.
Smaller particle size increases surface area and reaction rate.
Powdered calcium carbonate reacts faster than marble chips with hydrochloric acid.
Catalysts such as manganese dioxide speed up chemical reactions.
Inhibitors such as sodium chloride slow down chemical reactions.
Yeast added to hydrogen peroxide can be used to observe temperature effects on reaction ra
Magnesium ribbon dissolves faster in higher concentration hydrochloric acid.
Cessation of bubbling can indicate reaction completion.
